bench_ride.about: A man on a lorry's or a half-track's bench, facing inboard: sat back against the side, his rifle stood on its butt between his boots and both hands on it, knees together, the body taking the ride, looking about. The bench's top is 0.44 over the floor (the Truck's 0.455: he sits 0.75 cm lower there, its root_offset).

die_bench_slump.about: A man killed on a bench: struck back, his hands let the rifle go and it tips forward against his knees; he folds forward over his lap, his arms hanging between his knees, his head down, inside his own place on the bench (never onto the men beside him); the last pose held. Played from bench_ride.

bench_rise_l.about: Up from the left (rider.1-5) bench: he leans forward over his boots, stands, turning to his right as he steps into the aisle, and ends upright on the floor 0.38 ahead of the seat's point (toward the aisle), facing aft toward the way out, a little crouched, his rifle brought from between his knees up to the port. The game walks him from there to the way out (ride_clips.aisle).

bench_sit_l.about: Down onto the left (rider.1-5) bench: he comes to stand in the aisle 0.38 ahead of the seat's point, facing forward (up the aisle from the way in), turns his back to the bench and sits, his rifle going down between his knees; then bench_ride. (The other bench's rise, backwards.)

out_tail_a.about: Out over the Truck's dropped tailboard: two steps to the edge of her floor, a crouch, a jump out and down the 1.10 m to the ground, landing deep on both boots, coming up and stepping on; his rifle held at the port all the way. Root motion: the root goes with him onto the ground.

out_tail_b.about: Out over the Truck's dropped tailboard, another man's way: a stride to the edge and off it from his left boot, the right swung out over the board, landing low and coming up. Root motion as out_tail_a.

out_doors_a.about: Out through the Hanomag's open stern doors: ducking low under the canvas rolled across the top of her stern, up onto the lower stern plate in a crouch, and a jump down the 0.94 m to the ground, landing on both boots and coming up; his rifle at the port. Root motion: the root goes with him onto the plate and the ground.

out_doors_b.about: Out through the Hanomag's stern doors, another man's way: ducking under the rolled canvas, one boot up onto the stern plate and stepping long down off it to the ground from there, the other boot following. Root motion as out_doors_a.

out_door_a.about: Out through the M3's open stern door: squatting low under the canvas rolled across the top of her stern (0.79 m over her floor), short steps to the door, one boot out onto the small step under it and down to the ground, coming up as he clears the door; his rifle at the port. Root motion: the root goes with him onto the step and the ground.

out_door_b.about: Out through the M3's stern door, another man's way: squatting under the rolled canvas to the door and jumping down from her floor past the step to the ground, landing and coming up. Root motion as out_door_a.

way_out.open_first: play her `dismount` clip (it opens the tailboard) before the first man reaches the start

Truck.headroom: under her tilt 1.59 m over the floor, its rear opening 1.45: she carries men with it stowed (swap tilt off); a man under it creeps (head under 1.45)

way_out.open_first: play her `dismount` clip (it opens the stern doors) before the first man reaches the start

Hanomag.headroom: open-topped; the canvas rolled across the top of her stern is 1.18 over the floor at the doors: out_doors_* duck under it from their start

way_out.open_first: play her `dismount` clip (it opens the stern door) before the first man reaches the start

M3Halftrack.headroom: open-topped; her machine gun stands over the aisle 0.94-1.15 over the floor from 0.95 behind its pedestal (x -0.95) to the cab; the canvas rolled across the top of her stern is only 0.79 over the floor at the door: out_door_* squat under it from their start
